security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG translates Zalasr load-acquire (lb.aq/aqrl, lh.aq/aqrl, lw.aq/aqrl, ld.aq/aqrl) or store-release (sb.rl/aqrl, sh.rl/aqrl, sw.rl/aqrl, sd.rl/aqrl) as plain host loads/stores without emitting the required acquire/release memory barriers, OR QEMU's decoder accepts RESERVED encodings (loads with aq=0, stores with rl=0) and executes them as valid operations, OR QEMU allows ld.aq/aqrl and sd.rl/aqrl on RV32 where they must raise illegal instruction exceptions, OR QEMU TCG fails to enforce the atomicity guarantee — the instruction must appear as a single memory operation for RVWMO purposes rather than decomposing into multiple sub-accesses.
security_spec.summary: Zalasr load-acquire/store-release instructions require TCG to emit host acquire/release barriers and guarantee single-memory-operation atomicity; failure would break guest SMP synchronization, causing silent data corruption and race conditions in multi-hart emulated guests

findings.finding: Correctly rejects RESERVED encodings: returns false (→ illegal instruction) when aq=0, per spec norm:ldaq_no_aq_reserved which states 'The versions without the _aq_ bit set are RESERVED.'

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:ldaq_no_aq_reserved]#The versions without the _aq_ bit set are RESERVED.#

findings.finding: Correctly rejects RESERVED encodings: returns false (→ illegal instruction) when rl=0, per spec norm:sdrl_no_rl_reserved which states 'The versions without the _rl_ bit set are RESERVED.'

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:sdrl_no_rl_reserved]#The versions without the _rl_ bit set are RESERVED.#

findings.finding: REQUIRE_64BIT(ctx) guards ld.aq/aqrl before REQUIRE_ZALASR(ctx), correctly raising illegal instruction on RV32 per spec norm:ldaq_rv64_only: 'insn:ld.{aq,aqrl}[] is RV64-only.'
REQUIRE_64BIT(ctx) guards sd.rl/aqrl before REQUIRE_ZALASR(ctx), correctly raising illegal instruction on RV32 per spec norm:sdrl_rv64_only: 'insn:sd.{rl,aqrl}[] is RV64-only.'

Correct barrier semantics: acquire barrier (TCG_BAR_LDAQ) emitted AFTER the load, with optional release (TCG_BAR_STRL) when rl=1 giving seq_cst (TCG_BAR_SC=0x30). Per spec norm:ldaq_rcsc_semantics: 'The instruction always has an acquire-RCsc annotation, and if _rl_ is set the instruction has a release-RCsc annotation.'

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:ldaq_rcsc_semantics]#The instruction always has an acquire-RCsc annotation, and if the bit _rl_ is set the instruction has a release-RCsc annotation.#

findings.finding: Correct barrier semantics: release barrier (TCG_BAR_STRL) emitted BEFORE the store, with optional acquire (TCG_BAR_LDAQ) when aq=1 giving seq_cst (TCG_BAR_SC=0x30). Per spec norm:sdrl_rcsc_semantics: 'The instruction always has a release-RCsc annotation, and if _aq_ is set the instruction has a acquire-RCsc annotation.'

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:sdrl_rcsc_semantics]#The instruction always has an release-RCsc annotation, and if the bit _aq_ is set the instruction has a acquire-RCsc annotation.#

findings.finding: decode_save_opc(ctx, 0) correctly used for load-acquire (pure load, no store side). Does NOT use RISCV_UW2_ALWAYS_STORE_AMO, which would incorrectly promote load page faults to store-AMO faults in two-stage translation. Contrast with gen_amo() which uses RISCV_UW2_ALWAYS_STORE_AMO because AMOs both load and store.

Sign extension correct: lb.aqrl uses MO_SB, lh.aqrl uses MO_SW, lw.aqrl uses MO_SL (all sign-extend to XLEN), ld.aqrl uses MO_UQ (fills full 64-bit). Per spec norm:ldaq_signext_rule which requires sign-extension for sizes less than XLEN.

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:ldaq_signext_rule]#If the size (2^width+3^) is less than XLEN, it is sign-extended to fill the destination register.#

findings.finding: MO_ALIGN enforces natural alignment per spec norm:zalasr_natural_align. MO_ATOM_WITHIN16 provides zama16b misaligned atomicity granule relaxation per norm:zalasr_misaligned_pma_relax. The atomic load via tcg_gen_qemu_ld_tl with MO_ALIGN guarantees single-memory-operation atomicity on aligned addresses per norm:zalasr_atomic_ordered.

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:zalasr_natural_align]#The instructions in the ext:zalasr[] extension require that the address held in _rs1_ be naturally aligned to the size in bytes (2^width^) of the operand.#
[#norm:zalasr_atomic_ordered]#The ext:zalasr[] instructions are atomic loads and stores that support ordering annotations.#
